scene.synopsis: A woman gets dressed in front of a mirror in a messy, expensive bedroom while a man sits out of focus on the bed. She struggles with her dress zipper, fixes it, and they argue. She drops an earring, applies lipstick, and confronts him. She finishes getting ready, puts on heels, and grabs her bag. The camera pans up her body to reveal the man has vanished from the bed. She looks in the mirror, revealing her face is actually the man's face, softened and feminine.
